key.name: target-bus
key.summary: I²C bus of the selected monitor
key.description: Bus number (e.g. "7") of the monitor to control. Empty means use the first detected monitor.

key.name: detected-monitors
key.summary: Last scan result as JSON
key.description: Written by the extension after each ddcutil detect, read by the preferences dialog.

key.name: lg-buses
key.summary: Buses of the detected monitors made by LG
key.description: Written by the extension after each ddcutil detect, going by the maker ID. The preferences dialog offers LG mode while the selected bus is listed.

key.name: lg-mode
key.summary: Use LG's alternate input switching
key.description: Send the input to VCP feature 0xF4 from I²C source address 0x50 instead of the standard feature 0x60. Applies only while the selected monitor is an LG.

key.name: rescan-trigger
key.summary: Rescan counter
key.description: Preferences bump this counter to ask the extension to re-scan monitors.

key.name: show-hdmi
key.summary: Show HDMI (0x11) in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-hdmi
key.summary: DDC input ID for HDMI
key.description: Value sent when switching to HDMI. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: show-dp
key.summary: Show DisplayPort (0x0f) in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-dp
key.summary: DDC input ID for DisplayPort
key.description: Value sent when switching to DisplayPort. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: show-usbc
key.summary: Show USB-C (0x1b) in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-usbc
key.summary: DDC input ID for USB-C
key.description: Value sent when switching to USB-C. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: added-hdmi2
key.summary: Whether HDMI 2 has been added in preferences

key.name: show-hdmi2
key.summary: Show HDMI 2 (0x12) in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-hdmi2
key.summary: DDC input ID for HDMI 2
key.description: Value sent when switching to HDMI 2. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: added-dp2
key.summary: Whether DisplayPort 2 has been added in preferences

key.name: show-dp2
key.summary: Show DisplayPort 2 (0x10) in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-dp2
key.summary: DDC input ID for DisplayPort 2
key.description: Value sent when switching to DisplayPort 2. Empty uses the built-in default.

key.name: added-custom
key.summary: Whether the custom input has been added in preferences

key.name: show-custom
key.summary: Show the custom input in the tile menu

key.name: input-code-custom
key.summary: DDC input ID for the custom input
key.description: Value sent when switching to the custom input. It has no default, so the input stays out of the menu while this is empty.

key.name: custom-name
key.summary: Menu label of the custom input
